protocol: Native MuJoCo, 100 skill decisions (10 simulated seconds), zero spawn noise. Ducks start at x=-0.35, y=+-0.12, facing +x. Fixed stand/forward skills; stop variant switches both to standing once box x exceeds 0.68 m. Repeated zero-noise seeds are identical and are not independent statistical evidence. The falls field counts per-duck fallen decision flags, not fall events.
